title: RAVEN2
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#775, 2026-10-29), the Epic copy, Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 1 of 5: Netmarble's launcher setup fails. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: The Epic install is a 0.16 MB starter that downloads Netmarble's own launcher (Netmarble Launcher_EPIC 1.8.0) and runs its setup. That setup stops with 'cannot be closed, please close it manually', most likely seeing the starter itself as the running launcher, and Cancel ends the install. Whether the game behind the launcher runs is unknown.

knownIssues.symptom: Netmarble's launcher setup says the launcher cannot be closed, and Cancel ends with 'An unknown error has occurred (execute)'
knownIssues.cause: assumed: the setup sees the Epic starter as the running launcher. Not measured
